name: Kalwaria Zebrzydowska: the Mannerist Architectural and Park Landscape Complex and Pilgrimage Park
description: Kalwaria Zebrzydowska is a pilgrimage park in southern Poland, near the town that grew up around it. Early in the 17th century, chapels and paths were laid out across forested hills to echo the Passion of Christ and the life of the Virgin Mary. The landscape has barely changed since, and pilgrims still walk its trails today.
